subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should indexed transcript persistence facts become a supported public Plugin SDK write-lock API, or remain a bundled-only implementation detail for Codex and Copilot mirrors?
rationale: This choice determines a durable third-party compatibility contract and cannot be resolved from performance evidence alone.

options.title: Keep facts bundled-only
options.body: Move the indexed lookup capability behind a bundled-only facade and preserve the existing public write-lock API until broader plugin demand is established.

options.title: Sponsor a public SDK contract
options.body: Approve the new runner as durable plugin API and require generic semantics, upgrade expectations, and focused compatibility coverage before merge.

options.title: Pause the optimization
options.body: Defer the API expansion and retain the current mirror implementation until an owner selects a supported boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep facts bundled-only
recommendation.body: Move the indexed lookup capability behind a bundled-only facade and preserve the existing public write-lock API until broader plugin demand is established.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged transcript-index foundation and the concrete follow-up implementation, so they are the closest evidenced routing candidate for the API-boundary discussion.
